test_title: PYST 04: SSC Stenographer - General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Two statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

** Statements:**

Some brownies are healthy.

All brownies are cakes.

**Conclusions**:

I. Some cakes are healthy.

II. No cake is healthy.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/704b156d71deea7c530f00713d99a041604ee630f4e8c15ed7224c538163773d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some cakes are healthy → Follow (As some brownies are healthy and all brownies are cakes. As some part of healthy is common with brownies which whole comes in cakes, therefore it is true)

II. No cake is healthy → **Does not** follow (As all melons are apricots and all apricots are fruits. As some part of healthy is common with brownies which whole comes in cakes, therefore it is false)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
